briefing_title: AI 开放权重与安全转向并行，开发工具、科研与中国震后救援受关注
briefing_summary: 本期日报共八个版面。AI 头条为月之暗面发布 Kimi K3.1 Pro 并承诺 11 月 4 日前开放权重；OpenAI 称因重大风险停止用实时互联网训练模型，1Password、Canva、Uber 推进智能体应用。开发版面关注 Vercel 的反馈、预算与 MCP 更新。科研报道涵盖剑桥 10 美元光学传感器、近 3000 颗爆发恒星对暗能量的研究主张和 MIT 肌肉细胞游泳机器人。创业端关注 Warp Science、Daytona 与 Warhound 融资。国际聚焦美以伊朗计划、欧洲高温死亡研究和阿联酋漏油；中国关注巴青地震救援、长四乙一箭六星及雄安论坛。财经涉及标普风格分类调整、Kalshi CPI 期货和 Anthropic IPO；观点讨论网络常态、加拿大 C-22 与 iPhone 攻破议题。
briefing_title_en: AI Open-Weight Promise and Safety Shift Lead; Vercel, Science and China Quake Rescue in Focus
briefing_summary_en: This eight-section briefing leads with Moonshot's Kimi K3.1 Pro release and its promise of open weights by Nov. 4, alongside OpenAI saying it will stop training on the live internet over significant risks. Developer coverage focuses on Vercel feedback, budget and MCP updates. Science items include Cambridge's $10 optical sensor, a 2,884-star analysis suggesting dark energy may vary, and MIT's muscle-cell swimming robot. Startup coverage tracks Warp Science, Daytona and Warhound funding. World highlights include U.S.-Israel Iran planning, Europe heat deaths and a UAE oil spill; China coverage covers Baqing quake rescue, a Long March 4B launch and the Xiongan governance forum. Finance covers S&P style rules, Kalshi CPI futures and Anthropic's IPO window; opinion discusses cyber normality, Canada's C-22 and an iPhone hack claim.

S&P adopted new rules for classifying growth and value stocks; Kalshi pitched CPI futures to Wall Street; a leveraged semiconductor ETF suffered losses after record inflows; SpaceX’s mobile ambitions weighed on telecom stocks; and Anthropic faced a narrowing window to file for a November IPO.
